# @wthek/error-handling

> AI agent skill and Antigravity plugin for standardized HTTP error handling.

## Overview
`@wthek/error-handling` distributes production-grade error-handling instructions, reference guides, and recipes to AI coding agents (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Codex). It installs structured rules ensuring agents follow `@wthek`, `http-error-kit`, and `http-response-status-code` standards across Express, Fastify, Hono, Koa, NestJS, Restify, and MCP backends.

## Installation & Setup

### CLI Installation (Workspace Skill)
```bash
npx @wthek/error-handling
```
Installs the skill directly to `.agents/skills/wthek-error-handling/` in the current project root.

### CLI Installation Options
- `npx @wthek/error-handling` — Default workspace install (`.agents/skills/wthek-error-handling`)
- `npx @wthek/error-handling --global` — Global Antigravity plugin (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/wthek-error-handling`)
- `npx @wthek/error-handling --github` — GitHub workflow skill (`.github/skills/wthek-error-handling`)
- `npx @wthek/error-handling --dest <path>` — Custom directory destination

### Programmatic API
```typescript
import { installSkill, getSkillPath, getPluginManifest } from "@wthek/error-handling";

// Install to custom destination
const installedPath = installSkill({ dest: "./custom/skills/wthek-error-handling" });

// Get path to bundled skill directory
const skillPath = getSkillPath();

// Get parsed plugin.json manifest
const manifest = getPluginManifest();
```

## Bundled Skill Contents
- `SKILL.md` — Core instructions, philosophy, anti-patterns, and decision matrices.
- `references/` — Detailed reference guides for RFC-7807/9457 Problem Details, HTTP status codes, middleware, and transformers.
- `examples/` — Production-grade runnable server recipes for Express, Fastify, Hono, Koa, and NestJS.

## Safety Rules for AI Agents
1. Never write manual `res.status(code).json({ error })` response mutations; throw typed `KitHttpError` classes instead.
2. Transform validation failures using companion packages (`@wthek/zod-transformer`, `@wthek/typebox-transformer`, `@wthek/valibot-transformer`).
3. Always place error-handling middleware after application routes (or top of the stack for Koa).
4. Guard custom Express error handlers by checking `if (res.headersSent) return next(err);`.
